note: Live-runtime evidence, captured this session via a real GDB-RSP (DeSmuME) connection to the hash-verified, locally-supplied US ROM (profiles/civrev-us.json). All addresses are RAM addresses observed in one real playthrough (single human civ, Chinese/Beijing, Chieftain difficulty); the city-instance base address itself (0x021a29a4) is a per-playthrough heap allocation and will differ between runs - only the *offsets* and *field semantics* below are the durable finding.

city_instance_pointer_resolution.method: A code breakpoint at 0x020a9c34 (the city-focus switch dispatch, previously a static-only lead in evidence/re/city-yield-ui-leads.json) was hit while the in-game city panel was open. At that stop, register r9 held a pointer to a small UI-context struct; the city_instance pointer itself was read from [r9 + 0x124].
city_instance_pointer_resolution.confidence: proven for this playthrough's session; the [r9+0x124] resolution path is proven, the base UI-context pointer's own stability across sessions is not independently tested

fields.name: unknown_0x00
fields.evidence: Read consistently as 0 (single-civ game, civ index 0). Not independently proven to be a civ/owner index; plausible by position and by analogy with the separate 0xBC-stride array's own +0x00 owner byte, but not tested with a second civilization this session.

fields.name: city_focus
fields.evidence: Directly write-tested: writing 0 displayed "City focus is Balanced", writing 1 displayed "City focus is Gold" on the next rendered frame, both confirmed by reading the on-screen text. The consuming code is the switch dispatch at 0x020a9c34 (`ldrsb r0,[city_ptr,#6]; add r0,r0,#1; cmp r0,#5; addls pc,pc,r0,lsl#2`), matching the 4 named UI strings (Gold/Food/Production/Science) plus Balanced (0) and one further unnamed case (raw value 4, not exercised this session).

known_values.2: unresolved (predicted Food by UI string order, not exercised)
known_values.3: unresolved (predicted Production by UI string order, not exercised)
known_values.4: unresolved (predicted Science by UI string order, not exercised)

fields.name: built_buildings_mask
fields.confidence: PROVEN (carried over from the prior session's static proof, cross-validated live this session)
fields.evidence: Read as 0x00000001 (bit 0 = building index 0 = Palace) on a freshly-founded capital city, exactly matching the already-proven semantics from the building-availability function (analysis/buildings-model.md section 3/5).

fields.name: unknown_0x24
fields.evidence: Bit 0 set, consistent with the already-known `ldr r0,[r8,#0x24]; tst r0,#1` test in the building-availability function. This session additionally observed the SAME address read (as `[r0,#0x24]` off a register carrying the city pointer) inside the yield-recompute function at approximately 0x02052640 (`tst r0,#16` on this same word, a different bit) - confirms the field is read by at least two independent functions but does not resolve its meaning.

fields.name: unknown_0x38
fields.evidence: Unchanged carry-over from the prior static session's lead (`ldrsh r1,[r8,#0x38]; sub r1,r1,#0x64`). Small integer, plausibly a turn counter, not independently proven this session.

fields.name: current_food_yield
fields.evidence: Write site independently proven via a live write watchpoint (fires at the `strh` instruction at RAM 0x02052478, see evidence/re/city-yield-recompute-function-trace.txt). Field value cross-validated against the in-game city panel's displayed "City growth" surplus number across two independent snapshots: turn 1 (Balanced focus) value 2 matched an on-screen "+2 -> City growth in 14 turns"; turn 2 (Gold focus, after a real turn advance) value 2 again matched "+2 -> City growth in 13 turns".

fields.name: current_production_yield
fields.confidence: PROVEN by value correlation; write site strongly supported, not independently watchpoint-tested
fields.evidence: Turn 1 (Balanced): value 2, on-screen "+2 -> Warrior complete in 4 turns". Turn 2 (Gold focus): value 0, on-screen "+0 -> No production: Warrior delayed." Exact match both times; this is the field that most clearly disambiguated the 5-field order, since it diverged from the other two initially-tied fields (food, science) on turn 2.

fields.name: current_science_yield
fields.confidence: PROVEN by value correlation; write site strongly supported, not independently watchpoint-tested
fields.evidence: Turn 1 (Balanced): value 2, on-screen science flask icon "+2". Turn 2 (Gold focus): value 4, on-screen science flask icon "+4". Exact match both times.

fields.name: current_gold_yield
fields.confidence: PROVEN by value correlation; write site strongly supported, not independently watchpoint-tested
fields.evidence: Value 0 on both turns, on-screen gold coin icon "+0" (top bar) on both turns. Unambiguous because it is the only field to read exactly 0 in the first snapshot.

fields.name: current_culture_yield
fields.confidence: PROVEN by value correlation; write site strongly supported, not independently watchpoint-tested
fields.evidence: Value 5 on both turns, on-screen music-note culture icon "+5" on both turns. Unambiguous because it is the only field to read exactly 5 in the first snapshot.

turn_2.in_game_date: 3900 BC (one real turn advanced via the in-game End Turn control)

two_snapshot_differential.conclusion: The five city_instance+0x40..0x48 fields are PROVEN to be a persistent, once-per-turn-recomputed cache (not recomputed live per frame - forcing the focus byte alone, without a turn advance, did not change the displayed yield numbers), and their exact identity (food/production/science/gold/culture, in that byte order) is proven by two independent, exact numeric matches against the in-game city panel's own display.
